name: System Search 5
definition: Search for a system and a member of a system.

SystemIdentification.name: System Identification
SystemIdentification.definition: Identification of a particular cash clearing system.

MemberIdentification.name: Member Identification
MemberIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification of a member within a system, assigned using the member identification scheme of the system.

Country.name: Country
Country.definition: Country in which the system is located.

AccountIdentification.name: Account Identification
AccountIdentification.definition: Unique and unambiguous identification for the account between the account owner and the account servicer.
